summary: register, name and re-point plainkeep vaults (marker + registry)
usage: plainkeep vault list | status | register [<path>] [--name <slug>] [--default] --yes | rebind <name|id> <new-path> --yes | deregister <name|id> --yes | default <name|id> --yes
hints: A vault is identified by an immutable id in <vault>/.plainkeep/vault.json and NAMED by the registry outside every vault, so renaming or moving one never writes into it. `register` is also the bootstrap for a vault that predates init/migration. A moved vault is `rebind`, not a second `register` — rebind refuses if the marker at the new path carries a different id. Everything fails closed: unknown schema, malformed JSON, or a duplicate id/name/path refuses with the file named. NOTE: this does not yet change how a root is DISCOVERED (Task 1b) — `vault status` reports what today's rules select.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: registered vaults, which is the default, and whether each still has its marker (the default action)

actions.name: status
actions.summary: which root this environment selects and why, plus this vault's marker and registration

actions.name: register
actions.summary: mark a directory as a vault (if unmarked) and add it to the registry; needs --yes

args.name: path
args.help: the vault directory; defaults to the current directory

args.name: --name
args.help: registry name (lowercase slug); defaults to the directory name

args.name: --default
args.help: also make it the default vault

actions.name: rebind
actions.summary: re-point a registered vault at its new location (same id); needs --yes

actions.name: deregister
actions.summary: remove a registry entry; the vault and its marker are untouched; needs --yes
